text_block_list.text:
After a fierce battle, Мэйсё Дото wins
against
Т.М. Опера О. At last, the two
establish a rivalry.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото is delighted by this new

development in their relationship, while
T.M.
Opera O is excited to have
someone who will
encourage her growth.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The change is not only internal: their lap
times
also show improvement,
convincing Air Shakur
the two have
broken past their previous stat
ceiling.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's no longer certain who will emerge
victorious in
the race against the
previous generation. The two
head for
the Arima Kinen as true competitors.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
